snippet.title: Space Control | The Most Chaotic VR Space Job Sim | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
In Space Control you've been abducted by an intergalactic megacorporation, Glorpo Inc! Work off your debt with your alien crew - abduct new recruits, take care of alien babies and cook up some questionable space snacks! Watch the Space Control release date trailer for this upcoming VR narrative adventure simulation game. Space Control will be available on Meta Quest and Steam April 1st 2026!

Find Space Control here on stores: 
🔹Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1759150/Space_Control/
🔹Meta: https://www.meta.com/experiences/space-control/7192215547457949/

Watch the human creators Glorpo Inc abducted to make this video here: 
@Fynnpire : https://youtu.be/3edioWA90pA
​⁨@WhackyCast : https://youtu.be/tnUA4YioYjA
@AWolfinVR : https://youtu.be/iR_365sV0SI

📱 All Socials: https://linktr.ee/MoonMonsterStudios

Glory to Glorpo Inc!
